prerequisites: Competencies from the modules Object-Oriented Programming, Declarative Programming, and Algorithms and Data Structures are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to solve larger programming problems.
Students are able to use software development environments and software libraries for creating larger programs.
Students are able to select, test, evaluate, and apply suitable computer science methods for given problems.
Students are able to appropriately document and prepare obtained results in writing.
Students are able to solve tasks organized in teamwork.

syllabus_topics: Quality assurance (e.g., module and integration tests)
assessment_rules: The module is ungraded according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. A previous registration is required for this event.
